what_to_ask_the_supplier: Full legal name of the producing company
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Identifies the installation owner for the return audit trail

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Name and full address of the plant that made the goods
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Emissions are installation-specific; HMRC requires the production site

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Eight-digit Combined Nomenclature code of the good as imported
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Decides whether the good is in scope and which HMRC default value applies

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Plain description of the good (grade - dimensions - form)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Cross-checks the CN code and the production route

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Net mass of the consignment in tonnes (excluding packaging)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Emissions = mass x intensity; mass also feeds the GBP 50000 threshold test

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Customs value of the consignment in GBP
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Counts toward the GBP 50000 registration threshold (rolling 12 months)

what_to_ask_the_supplier: How the good was made (e.g. BF-BOF - EAF - DRI - clinker route)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Route drives the emissions intensity; HMRC defaults ignore route so actuals save money

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Verified direct emissions per tonne of product (tCO2e/t) - direct emissions only
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: This is the number reported to HMRC; indirect emissions are OUT of scope until 2029 at earliest

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Total direct embodied emissions for the consignment (mass x intensity)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Feeds the return: liability = emissions x sector rate minus carbon price relief

what_to_ask_the_supplier: List any precursor CBAM goods used (e.g. pig iron - clinker) with their direct emissions
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: UK CBAM charges direct emissions of precursors too - they must be included

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Main fuels and reducing agents used (coal - gas - electricity excluded for now)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Supports the intensity figure; electricity use is recorded but NOT charged until 2029

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Who verified the emissions data and to what standard (UK CBAM verification requirements)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Actual data must be backed by qualifying verification evidence or HMRC defaults apply
example_value: Verified by [accredited verifier] - report ref. VER-2026-118

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Carbon price already paid on these goods in the country of production (currency + amount per tCO2e)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Qualifying carbon price relief reduces the UK CBAM bill - but only with evidence
example_value: GBP 0.00 - no carbon price paid in Turkiye
source_document_to_attach: Carbon price payment receipt / official statement

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Document proving the carbon price paid and that it qualifies under UK rules
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Without evidence no relief is given even if a price was paid

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Country where the good was produced (not just shipped from)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Defaults are one value per CN code whatever the origin; origin matters for relief and exemptions

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Is the origin country covered by an ETS linked to the UK ETS (exemption route)?
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Goods from a linked-ETS country may be exempt - check before counting them

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Was the good originally produced in the UK and re-imported?
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: UK-origin emissions are not captured by UK CBAM

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Date the goods passed the UK CBAM tax point (import date)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Decides the accounting period and which quarterly sector rate applies

what_to_ask_the_supplier: UK CBAM sector rate for the quarter of import (published quarterly by HMRC)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Liability = emissions x this rate; illustrative Oct 2026 steel rate GBP 9.69 - NOT the final Q1 2027 rate
source_document_to_attach: HMRC rates page (gov.uk) - Q1 2027 rate to be published before end of 2026

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Accounting period the consignment belongs to (2027 = full year; quarterly from 2028)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: First return covers all of 2027 and is due 31 May 2028

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Name of the person at the supplier who supplied this data
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Follow-up route when data is missing or inconsistent

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Email of the supplier contact
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Supplier chase is written-only; this is the channel

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Status of this line: complete / partial / awaiting supplier / default used
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Gap log for the return - a default-based return CANNOT later be amended with actuals

what_to_ask_the_supplier: Anything else (scrap share - recycled content - mass-balance claims)
why_it_matters_for_UK_CBAM: Explains anomalies before HMRC asks about them
